title: Outbreak Zoom-out Picks
heading: The zoom-out: city, then peninsula, then country
intro: Kai asked for about 5 seconds of new picture to replace the quiet cup at the end of the outbreak chorus: zoom out from the ground to a whole city with several explosions, then a whole peninsula with tiny flashes. Here are three frames in zoom order, with 3 or 4 different stills for each. Pick one per frame (or none), and leave a note. These are stills only: no video credits are spent until you pick.

sections.lede: Same night as the chorus. Each frame is about 1.5 to 2 s. Frame C is optional: A then B already makes the zoom.

groups.title: A: a whole city burning (London)
groups.line: London, because the chorus already has Primrose Hill and the film's route runs through it. Fires are fuel depots and substations, as in the chorus: flat orange domes, not mushroom clouds.

opts.label: a: London from 9 km, slant west up the Thames, eight fuel-depot fires across the orange street mesh (the locked look)
b: above the cloud deck, a dozen fires glowing up through it, one white blast lighting a cloud bank (the Thames visible bottom right)
c: break: 400 mm from the North Downs, London's skyline in one burning band, an abandoned hatchback in the foreground (dusk-blue sky, not full night)
d: break: straight-down thermal, grey city, fifteen white-hot blooms (reads a bit like a map graphic)

groups.title: B: a whole peninsula, tiny flashes
groups.line: Four different peninsulas, each from a different height: Cornwall (the shape everyone knows), Kent (London's own corner and Dover), the Wirral (Liverpool's docks), the Solent (the refinery and naval harbours).

opts.label: a: Devon and Cornwall from 40 km, the whole peninsula, twenty pinprick flashes with smoke threads, Plymouth burning (edit adds the flashes)
b: from an airliner flight deck: the south-east corner and the Channel, matchstick flashes among the towns (edit adds the flashes)
c: the Wirral and Liverpool from 15 km, flashes along the docks, smoke drifting inland, red-lamp wind farm offshore
d: straight down on the Solent and the Isle of Wight, the refinery burning with a long smoke streak, flashes in the harbours

groups.title: C (optional): the curve of the country
groups.line: Higher still: the whole island going out. Different from the space-station window still from round 2 (OB2).

opts.label: a: low orbit, no window: Britain almost all dark, London the last amber blot, dawn edge over the North Sea
b: from the space station: cloud swirling over Britain, lit from beneath by dozens of fires like a storm made of fire
c: beside a high-altitude jet's nose, the horizon curved, Britain with black holes and thirty flashes (edit adds them)
